content: Backend foundation: db helpers, models, JWT auth utils, object storage module, add EMERGENT_LLM_KEY to .env
Backend auth & codes: admin email/password login, OTP code login, supervisor code generation/listing/clear, role-based deps
Backend core domain: karigars, process steps, bags intake (with photos), packets, movements with running balance/loss
Backend advanced: repack/split/merge/mixed packets, QC + rework, handovers, bag accounting + traceability, recovery allocation
Backend costing: labour ₹/kg, karigar payments, expenses, cost summaries, delivery/close bag, dashboard, history, demo reset + seed
Frontend foundation: theme tokens + fonts + i18n (Hindi/English), contexts, app shell + top bar
Frontend auth: login (admin + OTP), supervisor code dashboard panel, protected routes
Frontend screens: dashboard, bags list/intake/detail, packets + movement timeline, repack/split/merge/QC actions
Frontend screens: recovery, costing/expenses/payments, deliveries, settings, karigars
Test frontend end-to-end with testing agent; fix bugs; screenshots; finalize
